senses.gloss: m. (quæstionarius) torturer, executioner. Pesik. Shub., p. 159ᵃ; Yalk. Ps. 854; Yalk. Prov. 961 end, v. פַּרְקוּלָא.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:1:14">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵃ</cite> <he>נתזה החרב … של קוסנתירו … וקוסנתר נהרג</he> (corr. acc.) the sword rebounded from Moses’ neck against that of his executioner; … and the executioner was killed; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:3">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV</cite>; <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 7:5:2">Cant. R. to VII, 5</cite> <he>קוסנטר</he>, <he>קסטנר</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Devarim Rabbah 2:36">Deut. R. s. 2</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 167:2">Yalk. Ex. 167</cite> (not <cite ref="S01661"><he>קסט׳</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 1:12">Num. R. s. 1</cite> (ref. to <he>שאו את ראש</he>, <cite ref="Numbers 1:2">Num. I, 2</cite>) <he>כאדם האומר לק׳ סב וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>לקיס׳</he>, corr. acc.) as a man says to the executioner, take this man’s head.

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 35:5">Lev. R. s. 35</cite> <he>הושיב בו קוסטרינוס בשביל לשמרו</he> (some ed. <he>ום …</he>, read <he>קוסטנריוס</he>) he appointed an executioner to be the governor of the place (disturbed by rebellious hordes); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 670:2">Yalk. ib. 670</cite> <he>קיסטינוס</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:11:1">Cant. R. to VI, 11</cite> <cite ref="K00322"><he>כוסטריינים</he></cite> (corr. acc.).
<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 10:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. X, 10</cite> <he>כגון הק׳ שהיה מכה וכ׳</he> like the torturer that strikes and dislocates a rib and a vertebra at the same time; ed. Bub., a.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 650:1">Yalk. ib. 650</cite> <he>הקיסטור</he> (corr. acc.).—Pl. <he>קוּסְטִינָרִים</he>, <he>רִין …</he>, <cite ref="S00467"><he>קוּסְטְנָרִ׳</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 10:1">Pesik. R. s. 10</cite> <he>שמעו הק׳ ונטלוהו וכ׳</he> (some ed. <he>קוסברי׳</he>, corr. acc.) the executioners heard (the king’s order), and they took him (his son) to cut his head off. Y’lamd. to Deut. I, 1, quot. in Ar. <he>עשה … ולק׳ פסחין</he> he made Pharaoh deaf and the executioners lame (<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:30">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>סנקליטין</he>).

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6:6">Midr. Till. to Ps. VI</cite> <he>האף והחימה שני קוסטנרין של מית הן</he> ed. Bub. (oth. ed. <cite ref="S00472"><he>קוסטנרות</he></cite>) anger and wrath are death’s two executioners.

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 6:1">Ib.</cite> <he>ק׳ רעים</he> (not <he>קוסטנד׳</he>) cruel quæstionarii; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 635:1">Yalk. ib. 635</cite> <cite ref="S00431"><he>קונטסרין</he></cite> (corr. acc.); a. e.
